At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. 1 Solution Architect (f/m/x) 

The Solution Architect drives and leads the design, development, and delivery of end-to-end solutions across multiple products and teams.

In the Agile Delivery Client Coverage, we are responsible for a range of customer masterdata solutions for clients. You act as a crucial bridge between different technologies as well as between technology and business by transforming complex requirements into efficient, scalable, and modern solutions.

This role requires technical expertise, strategic thinking, and hands-on implementation to transform and future-proof the technical environment and landscape.

 

Your Mission at RBI

 

 * Lead the transformation of existing infrastructure and systems by implementing cutting-edge technologies to improve our operations.

 * Create concepts, visualizations, and designs for E2E solutions in both legacy and new technologies, with a focus on resilience, performance, and security.

 * Promote collaboration and consensus among various stakeholders by negotiating and advocating for solutions that align with our strategic goals.

 * Ensure the successful introduction of new systems and technologies.

 * Create a vision together with management and act as a sparring partner in transforming the area and driving technology renewal.

 

Your Core Competencies

 

 * Professional experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role in an enterprise environment.

 * Solid foundation in information technology, software development, system architecture, and IT infrastructure management.

 * Experience with various AI tools or LLMs in a work context.

 * Motivation to continuously learn and work at a strategic level.

 * Highly customer-oriented and results-driven approach.

 * Ability to collaborate in interdisciplinary teams and ability to drive change and innovation.

 * Experience in a financial institution is an advantage.

 * Proven negotiation and communication skills in English, German language skills are a plus.

 

What?s in it for you:

 

 * Global community: 75+ nationalities, English as the company language, and work permit support.

Join one of the fastest-growing companies! ¿ 1 Sales Enablement Manager (f/m/d) The role

We ship new features every week, and our sales team is growing across several markets. As Sales Enablement Manager, you make sure every seller knows what they're selling, who to sell it to and how to win the deal.

You'll train, coach and run role plays, and you'll connect Product and Sales. Your goal is to get new AEs to target faster and help the whole team win more, and bigger, deals.

What you'll do

 * Run weekly sales enablement sessions, including role plays, deal reviews and live practice.

 * Capture what our best AEs do differently and turn it into repeatable playbooks for the team.

 * Own AE onboarding and make it faster, so new hires reach their targets sooner.

 * Keep sales up to date on every product release. Explain what changed, who it's for and how to pitch it.

 * Create the material sellers actually use: pitch decks, talk tracks, objection handling and battlecards.

 * Act as the link between Product and Sales. Bring product updates to the team and bring field feedback back to Product.

 * Coach AEs one-to-one on calls and deals.

 * Track and improve the numbers: ramp time for new AEs, win rate and average contract value.

What you bring

 * You have experience in sales enablement, sales training or a similar role at a B2B SaaS company.

 * You have a sales background, ideally as an AE, so sellers respect what you teach.

 * You know sales methodology well and can turn it into practical, hands-on training.

 * You're comfortable leading a room and getting people to practise, not just listen.

 * You can take a complex product update and explain it clearly in minutes.

 * You're analytical and use data to see what's working and what isn't.

 * You're fluent in English. Spanish or other European languages are a plus.

Nice to have

 * Experience in a fast-shipping product environment, where the pitch changes every week.

 * Experience selling to SMBs or in a high-velocity sales environment.

 * Experience building an onboarding program from scratch.

What you get

 * High visibility. Your work shows up directly in revenue.

 * Close work with the CCO, the sales team and Product.

 * A team of ambitious people, many of them former founders.

 * Salary: €80000 - €110000.

Process

 * Intro Call (30 mins)

 * Skill Interview (60 mins)

 * Interview with CCO (30 mins)

 * Culture Call (20 mins)
